tagline: KMZ胶片单反相机，1981 年发布
description: KMZ于1981年推出的胶片单反相机。配备MC Helios-44M-6 58mm f/2, automatic diaphragm, filter thread 52mm。快门速度Horizontally-travelling, cloth focal-plane shutter, speeds 1/30 - 1/500 +B,。Fresnel matte glass screen。

specs.镜头: MC Helios-44M-6 58mm f/2, automatic diaphragm, filter thread 52mm
specs.取景器: of the 24x36mm area on the resulting negative, the actual area seen through the viewfinder is only 20x28mm
specs.自拍: activates by a small knob above the lever
specs.闪光灯: on front of the top plate, X sync.1/30, marked 30-X on the speed dial
specs.英文简介:
__NOTOC__
Zenit ET is a 35mm film SLR camera manufactured by Vileiskiy Zavod Zenit, (Vileiskiy Plant Zenit), A Soviet times plant for producing Zenit cameras for MMZ of BelOMO, near Minsk, former USSR, produced between 1982-1993 with a quantity 3,000,000.
